Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.5 of 2023, under Sections 386, 306, 509,
376-D, 377 IPC & Section 66-C, 67 of I.T. Act, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Sitapur, during trial.

3. It it argued by counsel for the applicant that in terms of the FIR, it was alleged that in the night of 22.12.2022, the daughter of the informant had committed suicide and she was buried thereafter.

Subsequently, on 31.12.2022, the mobile phone of the deceased was recovered, which demonstrated that one boy with the name of Salman was committing wrong with the daughter of the informant Mohd. Salman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Home ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23791524/
1 and the victim was supposed to do wrong with them, failing which, she was being threatened, as such she committed suicide.

entities.text: Mohd. Salman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In the light of the aforesaid allegations, it is argued by the counsel for the applicant that the mention of the accused Salman in the FIR is not the applicant, who has been arrested, as the applicant is working at Delhi.
5. He further argues that even as per the CDR records, relied upon by the learned AGA, there is no material to link the applicant with the offence in question.

6. He further draws my attention to the post mortem report on record, which indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and apart from ligature mark, no other injury is visible on the body of the deceased, in the light of which, it is argued that there is no material to implicate or charge the applicant for an offence under Section 376-B, 377 of the I.P.C.
7.

He further argues that there is no material to link the applicant for an offence under Section 306 I.P.C.
8.

Learned AGA opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant by arguing that from the recovery of the mobile phone, it is transpired that the accused used to harass and exploit the victim, because of which, she committed suicide, as such the victim denied to the applicant.

9. Considering the submissions made at the bar and perusal of material, prima facie, the post mortem report is silent in so far as the corroboration of offence under Sections 376 and 377 I.P.C.
are concerned.

Even for the sake of arguments, if the allegations are treated to be correct, prima facie, there is no material to suggest abetment at the instance of the applicant as defined under Section 107 of the I.P.C.

Considering the law explained in the case of Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs. Inspector of Police 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387, the applicant, who is in custody since 5.1.2023 and has no criminal history, is enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs. Inspector of Police 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1387
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. Thus the bail application is allowed.
